items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is not an insured peril (2.1, 3.1.4); clothing/jewellery are personal effects not insured (4.3(d)) and were in a conveyance away from the insured location (4.3(f)). Identical to reference case 35, so t = 0.
Conveyance-related expenditure is excluded (4.3(e), 5.2.5, 7.1.8(d)) and there is no insured event. Same as reference case 35, so t = 0.
